483	to the Master of the World, the moment I took
484	this upon myself, I actually canceled
485	my sovereignty over myself, seemingly.
486	And the question is: why would I agree to do such a thing?
487	So first of all,
488	this is exactly what stands here as a choice. This is exactly

490	and you decide whether you want to accept it or not.
491	And in this you are master. That is, you are master and sovereign
492	to decide to take upon yourself
493	the authority of the Holy One, blessed be He, or not.
494	Here your sovereignty is expressed, in agreeing to this.
495	But again I return and ask: say that here I
496	do have a choice to decide in advance whether I want or
497	do not want to accept the authority of the Master of the World
498	to decide for me what I must do.
499	Why would I want to do such a thing?
500	That is, you are being asked: look, you have free choice,
501	and within your free choice you
502	are asked to cancel, to give up and cancel your free
503	choice.
504	Why would anyone even consider such a thing?
505	After all, all I have is my sovereignty over
506	myself. So why would I agree to give that up?
507	And now we see that, in fact, after Moshe Rabbeinu
508	came with this proposal, which says very clearly:
509	the covenant between Me and you is that you will listen to My voice,
510	that is, when you choose to do or not to do something,
511	first you will have to consider the question of what is the will of
512	the Master of the World, and carry it out according to His will.
513	This is the covenant: "And now, if you will indeed listen to My voice and keep
514	My covenant, you shall be My treasured possession from among all the peoples,
515	for all the earth is Mine. And you shall be to Me a kingdom of priests
516	and a holy nation." These are the words.
517	"And Moshe came and called the elders of the people and set before them all
518	these words that HaShem had commanded him. And all the people answered
519	together and said: All that HaShem has spoken, we will do."
